C2.4.note: Input described as submitted upvotes. The word 'preferences' appears loosely, but no separate held attitude is modelled.

C9.2.note: The claim of representing minority opinions needs approvals to reflect voters' actual interests (sincere upvoting). The abstract's illustration says participants only upvote their interest, but this is not stated as a general assumption. The DM's behaviour assumptions are stated.
